newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG, IBM unit in PC venture - paper.
newsitem.headline: LG, IBM unit in PC venture - paper.

text.p: South Korea's LG Electronics Inc and International Business Machines Corp's subsidiary IBM Korea have agreed to set up a joint venture to make and sell personal computers, a local newspaper reported on Saturday.
The joint venture, to be named LG-IBM PC Co, will be capitalised at 30 billion won and IBM Korea will hold a 51 percent stake, the Maeil Business Newspaper said.
Company officials could not immediately be reached for comment.
The joint venture will incorporate the PC division of LG, a unit of the LG Group, and the PC and notebook computer divisions of IBM Korea, the report said.
The venture will assemble PCs at LG Electronics' plant in Pyongtaek, southwest of Seoul, and sell products overseas as well as in Korea, it said.
